youtube.title: The Island Where Visitors Get Killed. It's Illegal to Even Go Near It
youtube.description:
North Sentinel Island, in India's Andaman Islands, is home to the Sentinelese, one of the last peoples on Earth to refuse contact with the outside world. In 2004 they fired arrows at a Coast Guard helicopter; in 2006 two fishermen who drifted too close were killed; in 2018 American missionary John Allen Chau was killed after landing illegally. India bans visits to protect them.

📂 Case File #039: North Sentinel Island

Sources: Al Jazeera, "US missionary's death and a tribe that wants to be left alone" (2018), https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2018/11/missionary-death-tribe-left-181122151136507.html ; Quartz, "One of the world's most isolated tribes didn't always kill outsiders" (2018), https://qz.com/india/1473128/andamans-sentinelese-who-killed-john-chau-werent-always-hostile
Images: NASA (public domain); Havelock Island by Wikimedia contributor (CC BY 4.0); Coast Guard helicopter by Wikimedia contributor (CC BY 2.0).
